name: Pseudocode Constraint Embedding
description: Replaced the declarative mathematical axioms (Supremum-Infimum Separation, Orthogonality) with a concrete Python pseudocode firewall check. This forces the model to perform static analysis on the loop to deduce the p1+p2 <= T constraint, defeating models that rely on NLP pattern matching of mathematical terms to guess the required inequalities. Furthermore, the explanatory notes were stripped of explicit arithmetic deductions, forcing the model to derive the rules from the code.
